This text is from Homer’s *Iliad* (Book 19, lines 184–197). In this passage, Agamemnon responds to Odysseus, agreeing to formalize his reconciliation with Achilles through oaths and the presentation of gifts.

### English Translation

Then in turn Agamemnon, lord of men, answered him:
"I rejoice, son of Laertes, having heard your speech;
for you have gone through and recounted everything in due measure.
I am willing to swear to these things, and my heart impels me,
nor will I swear falsely before the gods. But let Achilles
remain here for a time, even though he is eager for the War-god;
and all the rest of you stay here together, until the gifts
come from my hut and we may strike faithful oaths.
And to you yourself [Odysseus] I give this charge and command:
choose the best young men from all the Achaean host
to bring the gifts from my ship—all that we promised
yesterday to give to Achilles—and to bring the women.
And let Talthybius quickly prepare for me, throughout the wide camp
of the Achaeans, a boar to sacrifice to Zeus and the Sun."

***

### Key Vocabulary and Contextual Notes

*   **ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν (Anax andrōn):** "Lord of men," the standard epic epithet for Agamemnon.
*   **ἐν μοίρῃ (En moirē):** "In due measure" or "rightly." Agamemnon is praising Odysseus for his diplomatic timing and his insistence on proper protocol.
*   **ὅρκια πιστὰ τάμωμεν (Horkia pista tamōmen):** Literally "let us cut faithful oaths." This refers to the ritual slaughter of an animal (the "cutting") to seal a bargain. 
*   **κούρητας ἀριστῆας (Kourētas aristēas):** The "best young men." Agamemnon delegates the manual labor of retrieving the gifts to noble youths selected by Odysseus.
*   **Ταλθύβιος (Talthybius):** Agamemnon’s herald, responsible for the religious preparations of the sacrifice.
*   **Διί τ᾽ Ἠελίῳ τε (Dii t' Eeliō te):** Zeus and the Sun (Helios) were standard witnesses to oaths because Zeus rules the heavens and the Sun sees everything that happens on earth.

Translate this (ancient) Greek text to English:
τὸν δ᾽ αὖτε προσέειπεν ἄναξ ἀνδρῶν Ἀγαμέμνων:
‘185χαίρω σεῦ Λαερτιάδη τὸν μῦθον ἀκούσας:
ἐν μοίρῃ γὰρ πάντα διίκεο καὶ κατέλεξας.
ταῦτα δ᾽ ἐγὼν ἐθέλω ὀμόσαι, κέλεται δέ με θυμός,
οὐδ᾽ ἐπιορκήσω πρὸς δαίμονος. αὐτὰρ Ἀχιλλεὺς
μιμνέτω αὐτόθι τεῖος ἐπειγόμενός περ Ἄρηος:
190μίμνετε δ᾽ ἄλλοι πάντες ἀολλέες, ὄφρά κε δῶρα
ἐκ κλισίης ἔλθῃσι καὶ ὅρκια πιστὰ τάμωμεν.
σοὶ δ᾽ αὐτῷ τόδ᾽ ἐγὼν ἐπιτέλλομαι ἠδὲ κελεύω:
κρινάμενος κούρητας ἀριστῆας Παναχαιῶν
δῶρα ἐμῆς παρὰ νηὸς ἐνεικέμεν, ὅσσ᾽ Ἀχιλῆϊ
195χθιζὸν ὑπέστημεν δώσειν, ἀγέμεν τε γυναῖκας.
Ταλθύβιος δέ μοι ὦκα κατὰ στρατὸν εὐρὺν Ἀχαιῶν
κάπρον ἑτοιμασάτω ταμέειν Διί τ᾽ Ἠελίῳ τε.
